question: Who among the following was the Union Finance Minister when the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arun Jaitley**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arun Jaitley** was the **Union Finance Minister** when the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojna** was **launched**.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana( PMJDY)
 
 
• It was **launched **on** 28 August 2014** from **New Delhi.**
 
• ​It is the **National Mission **for **Financial **Inclusion **launched **by the **Government of India**.
 
• It is started with the **aim **to **provide** universal banking services to **every unbanked adult.**
 
• There is** no minimum limit** to** maintaining an account balance(commonly known as a zero balance account)** opened under **PMJDY**.
 
• The Ministry of Finance is the nodal ministry for **PMJDY**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is the **current Union Finance Minister** of **India **as of now **May 2022.**
 
• **Rajnath Singh **is the **current Union Defence Minister **of **India**. as of now **May 2022.**
